Name: Hearty Haley
Author: tottlesfarm
Description:
Welcome to [b]Hearty Haley[/b], a Haley refresh mod.

Haley is one of my favorite bachelorettes, but I've never been a fan of the way she talks down on her 'former' interests. There's nothing wrong with loving fashion and magazines! So, instead of abandoning her interests, she just... grows [i]with[/i] them!

Haley now stays true to herself and grows as a person [i]all at the same time[/i]. Her dialogue has been completely edited to make more sense and reflect who is, as well as well over 100 lines of [i]new[/i] dialogue to further emphasize her personality. You'll be hearing about things like:

[list]
[*]How Haley feels about small-town life.
[*]Haley's love for Emily.
[*]Lesser known hobbies.
[*]Art school.
[*]The story of how Haley got her first camera.
[*]More details on Haley and Emily's parents.
[*]Favorite seasonal drinks & items.
[*]Childhood memories.
[*]Hidden talents.
[*]Embarrassing secrets.
[*]A fashion blog.
[/list]
Much like [b]Polished Penny[/b], I will add to and further edit Haley's marriage dialogue! I'll also eventually get to her festival and event dialogue.

[b][u][size=4]THINGS TO KEEP IN MIND[/size]
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]This version of Haley is based heavily on my personal headcanons. It's okay for people to have differing opinions and interpretations, so please be kind![/size]
[*][size=2]I imagine Haley is a [b]closeted lesbian[/b]. I have no control over what you do in your own game, but there [i]are[/i] vague mentions of Haley's distaste for men![/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]TRIGGERS TO LOOK OUT FOR:  [/b]Absentee parents, a lot of discussion of food and eating habits.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4][u]OTHER THINGS OF NOTE[/u]
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]While not at all required, it is recommended that you play with both [b]Hearty Haley [/b][i]and[/i] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23114]Polished Penny[/url]﻿[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2]My fiancée is the author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20099]Pride in the Valley[/url]﻿, another diverse and inclusive mod! I know I may sound biased, but it really [i]is[/i] an amazing mod. She is also the creator of this mod's primary image![/size]
[*][size=2]As always, we love, love, LOVE Airyn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿, which I am, once again, using in my screenshots.[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Make sure to delete the old Hearty Haley folder before downloading!
